description: Use when a court opinion that is not in the casebook has to become a casebook-style excerpt for students — "add this case to the addendum", "elide this opinion for class", "cut this case down to four pages the students can read", "make a casebook excerpt of X", "this case isn't in Choi, put it in the reader", "excerpt the Howey analysis from this opinion", "the TM mentions a case we don't have", "I want to teach this new decision next week". NEGATIVE ROUTING: compiling an addendum whose readings are already written is teaching:generate-addendum; retrieving an opinion with no elision is workflows:courtlistener.
